conventions.convention: Full AC is assumed. Manifolds carrying the compact calculus are smooth, compact and without boundary; bundles are finite-rank complex bundles. Sobolev levels and symbol orders are integers.
Fourier transformation uses the kernel exp(-ix·ξ), and quantization uses (2π)^(-n) exp(ix·ξ). Principal symbols therefore use the positive-frequency convention.

The simultaneous Sobolev closure requires convergence in every norm H^s → H^(s-m). It is distinct from closure at a single Sobolev level; the stated smooth-kernel regularity applies to elliptic operators in the simultaneous closure.

The equivariant analytic index is [ker P] minus [ker P*]. Compact-support homotopies have a common compact noninvertibility set. Controlled excision requires supplied compact equivariant ambient embeddings and exterior multiplication control in both kernel variables.

The associated-bundle quotient identifies (ph,f) with (p,hf). Horizontal lifts are the specified finite-chart lifts followed by T-averaging. Their joint symbols need only be elliptically homotopic to the connection-split product matrix.

The doubled-real Bott map is the even-to-odd part of exterior multiplication by z=x+iξ plus its Hermitian adjoint. In dimension one its clutching class is β=[γ]-1. The cotangent form is θ=Σξ_j dx_j, and the dθ orientation differs from the complex-coordinate orientation by (-1)^n.

The Hardy projection includes precisely Fourier modes n≥0. The geometric G-action on the circle is trivial; equivariance concerns the coefficient representation V. The rectangle uses orientation dx∧dξ, so its counterclockwise top edge runs right to left.

load_bearing.statement: The finite-chart classical calculus has chart-independent principal symbols, composition and adjoints, Sobolev mapping properties, elliptic parametrices and regularity. At each Sobolev level its norm-closed normalized symbol map is surjective onto continuous cosphere symbols with compact-operator kernel. Elliptic operators in the simultaneous Sobolev closure are Fredholm at every integer level, have smooth kernel and adjoint kernel, and have level-independent kernels. Compact Lie group averaging preserves the stated classes.

Under full AC, compact-support equivariant symbol triples on the cotangent bundle of a compact closed smooth G-manifold have a representation-valued analytic index realized by invariant elliptic operators, independent of the stated triple comparisons and quantization choices. The index respects restriction, coefficients and equivariant diffeomorphisms, computes alternating cohomology for first-order elliptic complexes, and satisfies controlled excision on invariant open manifolds with supplied compact equivariant ambients.

For the specified associated bundle and equivariant elliptic order-one operators A and B, classical or in the simultaneous Sobolev closure, the constructed block operator D is Fredholm with smooth defects and represents the graded product symbol. With K=ker B and L=ker B*, Ind_T D=Ind_T C_K−Ind_T C_L. The external-product identity also holds for compact-support open symbols defined through controlled compactification and excision.

For V=R^n with its standard O(n)-action, including n=0, the compact-support doubled-real Bott symbol defined by exterior multiplication by x+iξ plus its adjoint has a_O(n)(b_V)=1 in R(O(n)). Restriction along a compact Lie group homomorphism G→O(n) and tensoring by a finite-dimensional complex G-representation E give a_G(b_V⊗E)=[E].
